definition_zh: 有砟道床对轨道纵向移动的抵抗力。
usage_overview: 道床纵向阻力用于表征有砟道床对轨枕纵向移动的约束，可按每根轨枕所受阻力表示。在轮轨纵向相互作用分析中，可采用非线性关系描述这一约束。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

P073.title: A coupling method for wheel–rail longitudinal interaction
P073.authors: L Pan, L Xu, X DU
P073.label: Pan等（2025）

complete_examples.text: In addition, the effect of the nonlinearity of ballasted bed longitudinal resistance on the longitudinal dynamic response, and it is found that the nonlinear characteristics of the ballast bed cannot be ignored.

This paper is organized as follows: • The frame of vehicle-track dynamic interaction system is introduced for briefly in Section 2, in which the longitudinal wheel–rail coupling is considered; • In Section 3, the matrix coupling method for wheel–rail longitudinal interaction is proposed for novelty; • The reliability, efficiency, and accuracy of the proposed matrix coupling method for longitudinal interaction are analyzed in detail in Section 4; • In Section 5, the effects of the track irregularity and the nonlinearity of the ballasted bed longitudinal resistance on the longitudinal dynamic response of the system are analyzed in detail.
